openai.description: OpenAI GPT OCR via Responses API

gpt-5.6-sol.pricingNotes: OpenAI lists GPT-5.6 Sol Standard pricing at $5/1M input tokens, $0.50/1M cached input tokens, $6.25/1M cache write tokens, and $30/1M output tokens. OCR estimates multiply observed or heuristic token usage by uncached standard input/output rates. The gpt-5.6 alias routes to gpt-5.6-sol and is intentionally not registered separately. Batch, flex, priority, regional uplifts, cached-input discounts, cache-write charges, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: project/links/openai-general-ocr-text-links.md documents OpenAI file-input limits of 50 MB per file and 50 MB total across all files in a request. Image-input docs document PNG, JPEG, WEBP, and non-animated GIF support with request-level payload limits.

gpt-5.5.pricingNotes: OpenAI lists GPT-5.5 Standard pricing with short-context rates of $5/1M input tokens, $0.50/1M cached input tokens, and $30/1M output tokens. For prompts with >272K input tokens, OpenAI applies 2x input and 1.5x output pricing for the full session. OCR estimates switch bands from observed or heuristic input tokens; batch, flex, priority, regional uplifts, cached-input discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.
